calls.summary: Danielle Foster called Colibri Real Estate to ask how to get her real estate license and compared the Exam Preparation package to the Ultimate Learning bundle. Oscar walked her through the state-approved course hours and the included exam prep question bank, then booked a new advising session to finalize her enrollment. She left the call confident and ready to start her pre-licensing modules.

Aaron Whitfield reached out about the Becker CPA exam review and wanted details on adaptive practice and task-based simulations before committing. Lila explained the four-part structure and coaching support, then scheduled an advising session to map out his study timeline. Aaron was pleased with the clear guidance.

Priya Nadar called Colibri Healthcare about the nursing ce unlimited membership as her license renewal deadline approached. Rosey confirmed the accredited CEU catalog and auto-reporting to her board, then set up an advising session to help her plan her renewal hours. Priya appreciated the smooth process.

Gina Alvarez was a career changer calling Colibri Real Estate for the first time to get her real estate license and did not know where to begin. Lee collected her contact details, state, and timeline, explained The Basics pre-licensing course, and scheduled a new advising session to guide her enrollment. Gina ended the call excited to start her new career.

Robert Klein contacted McKissock about the USPAP update course and whether the credit hours would satisfy his appraisal continuing education requirement. Mary confirmed the regulator-approved hours and downloadable materials, then booked an advising session to enroll him. Robert was satisfied with the answers.

Tanya Brooks called ExamFX about life and health insurance exam prep and asked about the practice exams and pass guarantee. Sue outlined the progress analytics and the guarantee terms, then scheduled an advising session so Tanya could pick her start date. She sounded reassured before hanging up.

James Ortega called Colibri Real Estate to check the shipping status of the printed textbook included in his Ultimate Learning package. Mike found the order and confirmed it was in transit with a delivery window of a few days. James wanted only the tracking update and did not book anything.

Karen Diaz disputed a charge on her Becker CPE subscription that she believed had already been canceled. Jennifer reviewed the billing history and opened a case to investigate the duplicate charge. Karen remained frustrated and asked to be called back with a resolution.

Nathan Cole could not access his purchased USPAP course materials after logging into his account. Rose tried to reset his access and escalated the technical issue to support when the modules still would not load. Nathan was annoyed by the delay but agreed to wait for a fix.

Olivia Reyes called Colibri Healthcare to cancel her nursing ce unlimited membership because she was leaving the profession. Oscar processed the cancellation and confirmed no further charges would apply. Olivia was polite but firm that she did not want to renew.

Brandon Hughes left a voicemail asking about his real estate license CE renewal bundle and whether his state hours had been reported. The call rolled to voicemail after hours and no agent was available. He requested a callback the next business day.

Melissa Grant complained that the exam prep pass guarantee was not honored after she failed her salesperson exam. Lila explained the guarantee conditions and the documentation required to file a claim. Melissa was upset that the qualifying steps had not been clearly explained earlier.

Derek Simmons demanded a refund on his Becker cpa exam review after deciding to postpone sitting for the test. Lee outlined the refund policy and the prorated terms, which Derek felt were unfair. He asked to speak with a supervisor before ending the call.

Sandra Bell called Colibri Healthcare because her completed CEUs had not been reported to her nursing board and her deadline was near. Mary confirmed the reporting gap and escalated it as urgent to the compliance team. Sandra was worried and dissatisfied with how long the fix would take.

Gregory Payne was angry about an unexpected renewal charge on his McKissock Learning Hub membership that auto-billed without notice. Sue confirmed the auto-renewal setting and started a refund request for the disputed amount. Gregory remained frustrated and threatened to leave a negative review.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: Yes. The caller is transitioning from his current career and wants to become a real estate agent. He specifically asked about Pennsylvania licensing requirements, exam timelines, and the cost of the pre-licensing and exam prep bundle.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects to complete pre-licensing coursework within two to three months and then pass the licensing exam. He indicated he has evening and weekend availability for study but needs flexibility around his current work schedule.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent should have captured the caller's email address before closing, since that is a critical contact point for sending course enrollment details and advising session confirmation. Additionally, setting clearer expectations about what happens between now and the scheduled advising session would have improved the handoff.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi there, thank you for calling Colibri Real Estate. This is Marcus Bell. What can I help you with today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah, hi. I am really interested in getting my real estate license in Pennsylvania. I am looking for an online course to get started.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That is fantastic. We absolutely have the right program for you. To make sure we set you up with the best option, can I grab your full name?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure, it is David Winters.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: David, great to meet you. And just to confirm, you are looking to become a real estate salesperson licensed in Pennsylvania, correct?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. I want to make this transition happen pretty soon. How long does it usually take to get through the course and pass the exam?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great question. Most of our students complete the pre-licensing coursework in six to twelve weeks when studying part time, and then they usually sit for the exam within a month after that. We also offer an exam prep bundle to help maximize your pass rate. Can I ask what your state of residency is?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I live in Pennsylvania, born and raised. And that is helpful. What is the cost difference between just the basics and the exam prep bundle?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Our Colibri Real Estate Basics course is around one hundred and seventy dollars for Pennsylvania, and our Exam Preparation package, which includes the basics plus our comprehensive question bank and simulations, runs about three hundred and ten dollars. Both come with our pass guarantee.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That pass guarantee is really important to me. And I have evenings and weekends free to study. Do you offer that flexibility?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, David. Everything is self paced and available online. You can log in whenever you want, day or night. Most of our students study a few hours a week in the evenings. That works really well for career changers like yourself.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Perfect. So what is next? How do I get enrolled?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great. I am going to schedule an advising session with one of our enrollment specialists. They will walk you through all the program details, get you set up with your course access, and answer any other questions you have. Does Wednesday, October 23rd at six PM work for you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, that works perfectly.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent, David. We have you down for Wednesday at six PM. Our specialist will reach out to you beforehand with all the details. Thank you so much for calling Colibri Real Estate. We look forward to helping you get your license.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thank you, Marcus. Really appreciate it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You are welcome, David. Have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: David Winters, a Pennsylvania resident and career changer, called to inquire about Colibri Real Estate's pre-licensing and exam prep courses. Marcus Bell gathered David's name, confirmed his residency, discussed course pricing, timeline (six to twelve weeks), and the pass guarantee. David indicated evening and weekend availability for self paced online study. Marcus successfully scheduled an advising session for October 23rd at 6 PM without capturing David's email or setting specific expectations for the advising call itself.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus, great job walking David through the course pricing and timeline. Your structure was clean and you nailed the self paced pitch for his evening study needs. Two things for next time: make sure you grab the email before closing so the specialist can send confirmation and course materials, and take 10 extra seconds to set expectations about what happens on the advising call. Something like, 'Our specialist will review your learning style, answer questions about the exam timeline, and get you logged in.' That small step reduces no shows and keeps the momentum going.

qaPairs.question: How do I get my real estate license online?
qaPairs.answer: You'll start with your state-approved pre-licensing coursework through Colibri Real Estate, then complete exam prep before sitting for the salesperson exam. I can book a short advising session to map the exact steps for your state.

qaPairs.question: Which real estate package should I choose?
qaPairs.answer: It depends on whether you want just the required hours, added exam prep with a pass guarantee, or the full pathway with a textbook and first-year CE. Let's set up an advising session so a specialist can match a tier to your goals.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer courses approved in my state?
qaPairs.answer: We offer state-approved coursework across many states, and approval varies by profession and program. Share your state and ZIP code and I'll confirm availability before we book your advising session.

qaPairs.question: How much does the CPA exam review cost?
qaPairs.answer: Becker's CPA Exam Review pricing varies by package and any current promotions, so I don't want to quote an exact figure here. An advising session will get you a precise quote and the right study plan.

qaPairs.question: What is included in the Becker CPA prep?
qaPairs.answer: It includes adaptive practice, task-based simulations, and instructor coaching across all four exam parts. I can schedule an advising session to walk you through the full curriculum.

qaPairs.question: Do you have unlimited nursing CE?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Colibri Healthcare through Elite Learning offers an unlimited accredited CEU membership with license-renewal tracking. Let's book a quick advising session to confirm the right plan for your license type.

qaPairs.question: Is the USPAP course approved for appraisal credit?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our USPAP update and appraisal continuing education through McKissock are regulator-approved for credit hours. I can set up an advising session to confirm the hours you need for your state.

qaPairs.question: How do I renew my license before the deadline?
qaPairs.answer: We package your state-required CE hours so you can complete and report them before your renewal date. Tell me your profession and deadline and I'll book an advising session to keep you on track.

qaPairs.question: Do your exam prep packages have a pass guarantee?
qaPairs.answer: Many of our exam prep packages, including Colibri Real Estate and ExamFX, include a pass guarantee alongside practice exams and analytics. A specialist can confirm the guarantee terms on an advising session.

qaPairs.question: How long do I have to complete my courses?
qaPairs.answer: Most courses are self-paced with access windows that vary by program and state. Let's book an advising session so we can confirm the timeline for the program you're interested in.

qaPairs.question: Can I prepare for my insurance license with you?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, ExamFX offers life, health, and property and casualty pre-licensing and exam prep with practice exams and progress analytics. I can schedule an advising session to match the right course to your line of authority.

qaPairs.question: How do I become a certified teacher through Colibri?
qaPairs.answer: TeachNow through Moreland University offers an online, cohort-based teacher preparation and certification pathway with mentorship. Let's set up an advising session to review admission and the practicum.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer courses on mobile?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our pre-licensing and CE modules are mobile-friendly with video and reading you can complete on the go. I can book an advising session to get you enrolled and started.

qaPairs.question: What's the difference between pre-licensing and exam prep?
qaPairs.answer: Pre-licensing is the state-required coursework to qualify for your exam, while exam prep adds an adaptive question bank and simulated exams. An advising session will help you decide if you need one or both.

qaPairs.question: Do you have continuing education for appraisers?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, McKissock offers appraisal continuing education and USPAP updates with regulator-approved credit and downloadable materials. Let's book an advising session to confirm your required hours.

qaPairs.question: Can I get CE and pre-licensing bundled together?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Ultimate Learning package includes pre-licensing, exam prep, and a first-year CE head start. I can set up an advising session so a specialist can tailor the bundle to your state.

qaPairs.question: How much is a CE membership per year?
qaPairs.answer: Membership pricing varies by brand, profession, and any current promotions, so I'd rather not quote an exact number here. Let's book an advising session for accurate pricing and the best value plan.

qaPairs.question: Do you report my CPE hours for me?
qaPairs.answer: Becker's CPE subscription tracks and helps document your continuing professional education for license maintenance. A specialist can confirm the details on a short advising session.

qaPairs.question: I'm changing careers into real estate, where do I start?
qaPairs.answer: A great first step is your state-approved pre-licensing course, and we can add exam prep to boost your confidence. Let's book an advising session so we can plan your new career pathway.

qaPairs.question: Can I speak with someone about which program fits me?
qaPairs.answer: Absolutely, that's exactly what our enrollment specialists do on an advising session. Share your profession and ZIP code and I'll get you scheduled.

License Renewal and Continuing Education Support

convo.text: Hi there, thanks for calling Colibri Group. I see you were looking at our real estate licensing programs. Are you looking to get started with your real estate license, or are you seeking continuing education for an existing license?
Yeah, I'm looking to become a real estate agent. I live in California and I'm not sure which course package would be best for me to pass the salesperson exam.

Great, that's awesome. So you're brand new to real estate and you want to get licensed this year. Are you looking for just the required coursework, or would you prefer a package that includes exam prep and maybe some first-year continuing education to get you up to speed faster?
I think I want the full package, you know, something with the course, exam prep, and maybe the textbook. I want to make sure I pass on the first try and I'm ready to start right away.

Perfect, I'm connecting you with our real estate advising team right now. They'll walk you through the Ultimate Learning package, confirm your California residency for the state-approved coursework, and get you enrolled and started today. One moment please.

signals.name: Advising Session Booked (Conversion)
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["your advising session is booked (Agent)", "let's get you enrolled today (Agent)", "schedule your advisor call (Caller)", "book my enrollment session (Caller)"])

signals.name: Advising Session Discussed (Industry)
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["speak with an enrollment advisor (Caller)", "talk to someone about the program (Caller)", "connect you with an advisor (Agent)", "walk through your options (Agent)"])

signals.name: CE Membership Interest
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["CE unlimited membership (Caller)", "continuing education membership (Caller)", "learning hub subscription (Agent)", "unlimited courses for renewal (Caller)"])

signals.name: Competitor Course Mentioned
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["Kaplan (Caller)", "AceableAgent (Caller)", "The CE Shop (Caller)", "Wiley CPA review (Caller)"])

signals.name: Compliance Disclosure Given (Quality)
signals.rules: scorecard[State Compliance Disclosures] < 60 and duration > 45 sec

signals.name: Enrollment Support Empathy (Quality)
signals.rules: scorecard[Empathy and Rapport] < 60 and duration > 45 sec

signals.name: Pass Guarantee Inquiry
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["pass guarantee (Caller)", "money back if I fail the exam (Caller)", "what happens if I don't pass (Caller)", "guaranteed to pass (Agent)"])

signals.name: Price Sensitivity Objection
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["too expensive (Caller)", "cheapest pre-licensing course (Caller)", "do you have any discounts (Caller)", "can't afford that right now (Caller)"])

signals.name: Quote Provided
signals.rules: signal = "Ultimate Learning Package" or signal = "Exam Preparation Package"
